title: Pas spectral
approval_scope: Full displayed RP, current/next values, costs/cooldown and destination/movement-reaction conditions accepted as provisional balance. Unshown full curves, detailed movement/stacking/turn cases and native visuals remain pending.
accepted_conditions: Adjacent free known passable destination; walls and obstacles block movement.
Dodge bonus added to ordinary dodge; available for reactions caused by movement.
unshown_rules_approval: Full rank curves, ordinary dodge/hit bounds, exact duration/turn counting, diagonal/corner movement cases, recast stacking/refresh and resource atomicity, attribute/implant combinations and magic cost reductions remain pending where not already accepted. No teleport through walls, forced enemy miss, attack, percentage dodge chance, incompatible-weapon lock or heavy-weapon exclusion introduced.
